subject: Exhibit freight re-route + warehouse cutoff coordination
messages:
From: Laura Chu <laura.chu@acmevents.com>
To: tessa_morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-04-08T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Confirmation of crate ETA and on-site receiving window

Hi Tessa —

Quick note: the event site (Moscone North) needs the crate to arrive between 05/04 08:00-12:00 for drayage-handling to avoid a late placement fee. Allied Drayage gave us a tentative pickup today, estimated delivery 05/03 evening, but they flagged the consignee address as different from the original paperwork. Can you confirm Redwood's receiving address on the Bill of Lading and whether you can accept an earlier warehouse drop if necessary?

Also copying Marissa so we can sync on AV checklist.

Thanks,
Laura
Laura Chu
Senior Event Producer
Acme Events

From: Allied Drayage <ops@allieddrayage.com>
To: tessa_morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: BlueHarbor Customs <broker@blueharbor.com>, WestCo Warehouse <pier23-ops@westco.com>
Date: 2026-04-09T16:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Exhibit crate pickup — customs hold (need commercial invoice)

Tessa —

We attempted pickup this morning but the customs agent placed a temporary hold at the outbound yard: the shipment is missing a commercial invoice and the consignee name on the manifest ("Redwood Inference Inc.") does not exactly match the name on the carrier paperwork. Per customs, that discrepancy is preventing export clearance. We need a signed commercial invoice and corrected BOL before we can load.

If we don't clear by 04/10 06:00 (PST), the carrier will have to rebook outbound space and there will be a $420 rebooking fee plus potential hold charges at the pier.

Attachment: hold_notice_8701.pdf (stub)

— Marcus, Operations Supervisor
Allied Drayage
ops@allieddrayage.com
+1 415 555 0147

From: tessa_morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
To: dev_patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, logan_wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-04-09T17:02:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Exhibit crate pickup — customs hold (need commercial invoice)

Team — forwarding Allied's hold notice. This crate contains our trade show booth (AV racks, banners). We cannot afford a missed sailing; the event move-in is timeboxed.

Actions:
- Dev: can you confirm whether Procurement already uploaded the commercial invoice to the shipment record? If not, please prepare and sign a CI and send to Allied + BlueHarbor immediately.
- Marissa: please confirm the consignee name we used when ordering the crate and whether we can accept an early warehouse drop at WestCo if Allied is forced to rebook.
- Logan: if we have to re-route to the WestCo yard for receiving, can you coordinate a same-day shuttle to Moscone on 05/04? Estimate shuttle cost and confirm availability.

I am putting a hard cutoff: if we don't get clearance by tomorrow 06:00 PST we use WestCo as an interim receive and trigger the re-route. Apologies for the rush — this needs hands-on.

Thanks,
Tessa Morgan
Field Marketing Manager
Redwood Inference
Office: +1 510 555 0192

From: dev_patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
To: tessa_morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, logan_wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>
Cc: BlueHarbor Customs <broker@blueharbor.com>, Allied Drayage <ops@allieddrayage.com>
Date: 2026-04-10T05:48:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Exhibit crate pickup — commercial invoice uploaded + provisional re-route

Tessa / team —

I generated and signed the commercial invoice (attached: commercial_invoice_8701.pdf) and updated the Bill of Lading with the exact legal consignee line: "Redwood Inference, Inc. (EIN: 12-3456789)". Allied, please confirm receipt and restart export clearance. BlueHarbor, please attach this CI to the customs submission.

Given the tight window, Allied and I also pre-authorized a contingency re-route to WestCo yard with an estimated same-day transfer fee of $650 (shuttle + handling). Logan: I left a note with WestCo to hold the tentative slot — they asked for an ETA and photos of the pallets for capacity planning (see attached photo_pallets.jpg).

Attachments: commercial_invoice_8701.pdf, BOL_8701.pdf, photo_pallets.jpg

— Dev Patel
Procurement & Events Operations
Redwood Inference

From: WestCo Warehouse <pier23-ops@westco.com>
To: tessa_morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>, dev_patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Allied Drayage <ops@allieddrayage.com>
Cc: logan_wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-04-10T14:33:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Exhibit crate pickup — receiving confirmed (conditional)

Hi all —

We received the pre-alert and the photos. WestCo can accept the crate as an interim receive and provide indoor storage until move-in, conditional on the following:
- Commercial invoice and corrected BOL on file (we have copies attached).
- Arrival before 04/11 08:00 PST to avoid an overtime handling fee ($295).
- Prepayment of handling/shuttle fee ($650) or a PO number for net-30 billing.

We will email a formal warehouse_receive_notice.pdf once Allied confirms delivery appointment. If Allied cannot clear customs in time, please instruct them to deliver to WestCo c/o Redwood Inference — Pier 23, Rack 4.

Kind regards,
Carmen Ruiz
Yard Operations Manager
